=== Possibly faulty data and open points ===
* The Alderaan Regional posts give only the first name 'Peter'; he is identified as Peter Nordstrom by the PC Worlds qualifier list (Day 2 bye) and his 'Alderaan Regional 2005' card credit. The forum user futantshadow ('Peter', Sonora) is the same winner (he asks how to design the prize card). The Sonora co-host 'Peter' in Clayton Atkin's January 2004 post is taken to be the same Sonora player.
* Alderaan Regional 2005 has no wiki page; row unlinked
